UFC CEO Dana White Declines White House Press Secretary Role

UFC President Dana White has turned down an offer to become White House Press Secretary, a role President Donald Trump had suggested he might take. Trump later stated he was "only kidding" about the offer. White was seen taking questions at a podium during a White House briefing.
